name: sql_server_schema_item
expression:
let
    Source = Sql.Database("sql.example.net", "SalesDB"),
    dbo_Sales = Source{[Schema="dbo", Item="Sales"]}[Data]
in
    dbo_Sales

name: sql_server_native_query
expression:
let
    Source = Sql.Database("sql.example.net", "SalesDB", [Query="select * from dbo.Sales"])
in
    Source

name: bigquery_project_dataset_table
expression:
let
    Source = GoogleBigQuery.Database(null),
    proj = Source{[Name="analytics"]}[Data],
    ds = proj{[Name="sales_ds", Kind="Schema"]}[Data],
    tbl = ds{[Name="orders", Kind="Table"]}[Data]
in
    tbl

name: snowflake_database_schema_table

    sch = db{[Name="PUBLIC", Kind="Schema"]}[Data],
    tbl = sch{[Name="ORDERS", Kind="Table"]}[Data]

name: postgresql_name_navigation

name: odbc_query_dsn

name: powerbi_dataflow_entity
expression:
let
    Source = PowerBI.Dataflows(null),
    Workspaces = Source{[Id="Workspaces"]}[Data],
    W = Workspaces{[workspaceId="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]}[Data],
    D = W{[dataflowId="11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"]}[Data],
    E = D{[entity="Attribusi", version=""]}[Data]
in
    E

name: folder_file_content
expression:
let
    Source = Folder.Files("D:\data"),
    F = Source{[#"Folder Path"="D:\data\", Name="a.csv"]}[Content],
    C = Csv.Document(F)
in
    C

name: google_sheets_table

    T

name: odata_entity
expression:
let
    Source = OData.Feed("https://example.net/odata"),
    Customers = Source{[Name="Customers"]}[Data]
in
    Customers

name: bigquery_aad_incremental_parameterized
expression:
let
    Source = GoogleBigQueryAad.Database(ProjectID, [Implementation = "2.0", UseStorageApi = null]),
    Nav1 = Source{[Name = ProjectID, Kind = "Database"]}[Data],
    Nav2 = Nav1{[Name = DatasetID, Kind = "Schema"]}[Data],
    Nav3 = Nav2{[Name = "sales_profile", Kind = "Table"]}[Data],
    Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Nav3, {"engine_no", "qty"}),
    Renamed = Table.RenameColumns(Selected, {{"engine_no", "Engine No"}, {"qty", "QTY"}}),
    Filtered = Table.SelectRows(Renamed, each [Engine No] <> null and [QTY] >= RangeStart and [QTY] < RangeEnd)
in
    Filtered

name: bigquery_aad_native_concatenated_sql
expression:
let
    SqlQuery = "select `work_date`, `qty` from `"&DatasetID&"`.`sales_daily` where `work_date` >= '"&Date.ToText(Date.From(RangeStart), [Format="yyyy-MM-dd"])&"'",
    Source = Value.NativeQuery(GoogleBigQueryAad.Database(ProjectID, [Implementation = "2.0"]){[Name = ProjectID]}[Data], SqlQuery, null, [EnableFolding = true]),
    Renamed = Table.RenameColumns(Source, {{"work_date", "Date"}, {"qty", "QTY"}})
in
    Renamed
